findings.finding: Current route loads attributes but never renders them; selected Filtek and long-name LUMEX pages have no specifications section or variant/package controls.
Variant identity is discarded in projection. Global cheapest compares raw sale prices across packaging; explanatory text does not make different packs comparable.
findings.evidence: page.tsx fromComparison, cheapest; functional audit catalog section

findings.finding: Catalog showed10 suppliers; selected Filtek page showed0. Same empty state without selected city and for LUMEX. Root cause not diagnosed in this design-only task; do not reseed or invent live offers.
Active choose-supplier anchor with zero offers creates a dead end. Empty promotions panel occupies a large portion of the page before the actual empty offers message.
Single noninteractive image, no thumbnail gallery, zoom, technical drawing or photo/package identity confirmation. On mobile photo precedes product title.
Long buyer decision path: no compact key facts, no offer sorting/filtering, repeated contacts/question button/quantity blocks make large supplier lists tall.
findings.evidence: supplier-offers.tsx and supplier-offers.module.css; populated runtime rows unavailable in observed local data

findings.finding: available=false is labelled Under order despite disabled purchase. Availability boolean alone does not establish preorder eligibility.

proposal.principle: Identify exact product + variant + sale package, then compare supplier offers on equal terms, choose supplier explicitly, add quantity in sale units.
proposal.firstScreen: Breadcrumb, full title, brand/manufacturer/code, gallery, selectable variants/packages, 4-6 short relevant facts, price range for selected package and available supplier count, choose-supplier anchor.
proposal.supplierRows: Supplier/profile + verified evidence/rating with sample size if available; available sale units/freshness if supported; city/method/lead time/shipping fee or request; exact package and minimum/increment; price per package plus normalized price; quantity, calculated line subtotal, add button. Contact/question as secondary expandable information.
proposal.ranking: Default lowest product subtotal among eligible offers for chosen variant/package/quantity; state if delivery excluded. With complete shipping quotes allow total delivered sort. Unknown quotes never assumed zero. Faster delivery/rating sorts only with comparable verified data. No opaque best seller badge.
proposal.below: Supplier comparison first, then anchored specifications, description, manufacturer instructions/documents. Seller reviews on seller profile; product reviews separate only if supported. No empty promotion panels; real applicable promotion in relevant offer row.
proposal.mobile: Title before gallery, swipe with visible buttons, selected variant/package and price before list, supplier rows become stacked cards,44px targets; sticky Choose supplier before selection, chosen supplier+subtotal+Add only after explicit choice; no horizontal offer table.
states: no matching variant or city with reset action
no current offers without buy CTA
API error retains product information and Retry
stale/unknown stock not presented as available
invalid min/increment keeps typed value and inline error
unknown write outcome links cart before retry
price/stock changes require revalidation and acknowledgment
proposal.futureOptions: Gallery zoom, manufacturer code copy/share exact selection, contextual supplier question, specifications search for complex equipment. Favorites/stock subscriptions and product-review system need independent working flows; not decorative controls. No medical equivalence recommendation without curated compatibility data.

dependencies.existing: Live comparison, package name/quantity/unit, normalized price, min/increment, delivery rules, verified markers, supplier official contact, cart actions and contextual offer question
dependencies.requiresWork: Expose/select variantId and package identity in page, exact count consistency, gallery/media identity, render attributes, truthful availability, optional quantity-aware comparison
dependencies.notCertified: Aggregated reservable units/lot expiry, guaranteed delivery date and delivered total, supplier ratings complete apps/web flow R7.5, document eligibility, package conversion UOM contract. Do not claim ready from mockup.
